newsitem.title: USA: Casino Magic sells stake in Argentina unit.
newsitem.headline: Casino Magic sells stake in Argentina unit.

text.p: Casino Magic Corp, a casino operator, said it sold 49 percent of its wholly owned Argentina subsidiary, Casino Magic Neuquen SA, to Crown Casino Corp.

Under terms of the sale, Casino Magic received $7.0 million cash and will continue to manage, for a fee, the casino operations in Neuquen City and San Martin de los Andes, Argentina. In addition, Crown Casino, under certain conditions, may fund additional expansion opportunities, which would be jointly developed.

Casino Magic said net proceeds from the sale were expected to be used to help develop Mississippi Gulf Coast properties, including a 378-room hotel tower in Biloxi, which is currently under construction.
